<function name="GetJumpPower" parent="Player" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns the jump power of the player</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number">Jump power</ret>
	</rets>
</function>

<example>
	<description>Prints 1st player's jump power</description>
	<code>print( Entity( 1 ):GetJumpPower() )</code>
	<output>200</output>

</example>
